claims.label: Itemized errata
claims.derive: len(rows)

claims.label: Processor families
claims.derive: len({r['processor_name'] for r in rows})

claims.label: Escapes at integration seams (%)
claims.derive: 100*sum(1 for r in rows if r['subsystem_category']!='Execution Units / ALU')/len(rows)

claims.label: Execution units / ALU (%)
claims.derive: 100*sum(1 for r in rows if r['subsystem_category']=='Execution Units / ALU')/len(rows)

claims.label: Modules parsed
claims.derive: len(rows)

claims.label: Benchmark median syntax nodes
claims.derive: median([int(r['concrete_syntax_nodes']) for r in rows if r['corpus_category']=='AI benchmark reference RTL'])

claims.label: Production median syntax nodes
claims.derive: median([int(r['concrete_syntax_nodes']) for r in rows if r['corpus_category']=='Production-oriented open RTL'])

claims.label: Complexity ratio
claims.derive: median([int(r['concrete_syntax_nodes']) for r in rows if r['corpus_category']=='Production-oriented open RTL'])/median([int(r['concrete_syntax_nodes']) for r in rows if r['corpus_category']=='AI benchmark reference RTL'])

claims.label: Peak in-place software dividend
claims.derive: max(float(r['normalized_in_place_dividend']) for r in rows if r['normalized_in_place_dividend'])

claims.label: Entry cost collapse, 1981 to 2026
claims.derive: [float(r['participant_nominal_cost_usd']) for r in rows if r['year']=='1981'][0]/[float(r['participant_nominal_cost_usd']) for r in rows if r['year']=='2026'][0]

claims.label: Rows with sentinel collapse factor (must be 0)
claims.derive: sum(1 for r in rows if float(r['cost_collapse_factor_vs_1981_dedicated'])>100000)

claims.label: Cumulative mean mitigation tax (%)
claims.derive: max(float(r['cumulative_mean_tax_pct']) for r in rows if r['cumulative_mean_tax_pct'])

claims.label: Placement runs
claims.derive: len(rows)

claims.label: Runs passed
claims.derive: sum(1 for r in rows if r['status']=='pass')

claims.label: Distinct floorplan hashes
claims.derive: len({r['floorplan_odb_sha256'] for r in rows})

claims.label: Instance area spread (%)
claims.derive: spread([float(r['detailedplace_instance_area_um2']) for r in rows])

claims.label: Setup slack spread (%)
claims.derive: spread([float(r['detailedplace_setup_wns_ns']) for r in rows])

claims.label: Firm-years
claims.derive: len(rows)

claims.label: 2 nm design cost per SoC ($M)
claims.derive: min(float(r['design_cost_per_soc_usd_million']) for r in rows if r['leading_process_node_nm']=='2')

claims.label: Peak R&D intensity (%)
claims.derive: max(float(r['rd_intensity_pct']) for r in rows if r['rd_intensity_pct'])
